status.description: COMPLETED: all acceptance criteria met. BLOCKED: could not proceed because something outside your control is missing or was denied. FAILED: you attempted the task and it did not meet the acceptance criteria.

summary.description: What you did and the outcome, in plain language.

filesChanged.description: Paths you modified, relative to the repository root. Empty if none.

checks.description: Verifications you performed. Empty if none.

blockers.description: What prevented completion. Must be empty only if status is COMPLETED and nothing blocked you.

findings.description: Relevant observations for the next step. Empty if none.
